summary: FatPipe Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01, 9.01) announcing a $7.0 million contract award to provide network edge products and monitoring services to schools. This is a routine operational event—a press release about a customer win—not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The filing is purely informational and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
